name: Get a chat alert when a new stable n8n version is released (self-hosted upgrade reminder)

parameters.content:
## Know when to upgrade your self-hosted n8n
**Who it's for:** anyone running n8n on their own server (Docker, npm, Kubernetes) who wants to hear about new stable versions without watching GitHub.

**What it does:** once a day it reads n8n's GitHub releases, skips pre-releases and other packages, and compares them with the version you run. When there's something newer it posts one message: the latest stable version, how many releases you're behind, a link to each, and a warning on a **major version jump** (read the breaking changes first). It remembers the last version it told you about, so you get one message per new release, not one per day.

### Setup (2 minutes)
1. In **Settings**: set `currentVersion` to the version you run (Settings > About n8n, or `docker exec <container> n8n --version`) and paste your chat incoming webhook URL.
2. **Execute workflow** to test, then **Publish** (activate). The "already told you" memory only works in published runs.
3. After you upgrade, update `currentVersion`.

Uses the public GitHub API without a token (60 requests/hour limit; this uses 1 per day).

Before upgrading: back up the database and keep your `N8N_ENCRYPTION_KEY`. Step-by-step: https://onyxaholguin-cyber.github.io/sheet-and-flow/tutorials/update-self-hosted-n8n-docker/
